postgres_adapter_smoke.role_privileges: USAGE on iteration2_v2; SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE on notification_event; no schema CREATE or table DELETE.
checks: Runtime repository factory uses PostgreSQL with existing URL selection.
Duplicate pending, failed, and sent keys are suppressed, including a fresh repository instance.
Failed state stores at most 500 error characters.
Sent state stores provider ID and timestamp and clears the error.
The same event ID in a different trip is a separate event.

neon_history_preflight.scope: Read-only snapshot; recheck after stopping old writers at deployment.

remaining_activation: Stop old API instances/writers, verify or transfer history if rows exist, then deploy/restart the updated backend with the same runtime URL.
